name: Iron Pike
summary: In Lakeshire, builders need Iron Pike supplies to repair the Everstill Bridge. Redridge gnolls seized the shipment from Stormwind, leaving the town short of iron.

sections.title: Stolen Caravan Cargo
sections.body: After Blackrock orc attacks, Lakeshire spent its metal reserves on armor, blades, and ammunition. Builders then asked Stormwind City for more iron, but Redridge gnolls hijacked the caravan on the road. They took crates of iron pikes and rivets north into the hills, and work on the Everstill Bridge stopped.

sections.title: Rebuilding the Span
sections.body: Foreman Oslow oversees the bridge's reconstruction and needs the stolen hardware. Without the heavy pikes to strengthen its stone and timber frame, the bridge leaves Lakeshire partly cut off from the northern road. It also leaves the town open to further incursions.

faq.q: Why are the gnolls carrying construction pikes?
aliases: why do gnolls have iron pikes
where did gnolls get iron pikes
faq.answer: Redridge gnolls ambushed a supply caravan traveling from Stormwind to Lakeshire. They scattered into the Redridge hills with crates of stolen construction supplies, including iron pikes and rivets.

faq.q: Who needs these iron pikes in Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Foreman Oslow needs the pikes to rebuild the Everstill Bridge across Lake Everstill. Recent orc attacks forced Lakeshire to melt its iron reserves into weapons and armor, leaving no spare iron.

faq.q: Where can these iron pikes be recovered?
faq.answer: Redridge gnolls hold the pikes in their camps in the hills and ridges north of Lakeshire.

faq.q: Why couldn't Lakeshire just forge their own iron pikes?
faq.answer: Lakeshire used its local iron supply fighting the Blackrock orcs, melting it into swords, bullets, and protective gear. The town had to ask Stormwind for new iron for construction.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, recovering the stolen supplies helps secure Lakeshire's crossings and strengthen Stormwind's eastern border against Blackrock aggression.
As a blacksmith, you can see how war strained local smiths: they had to use all their raw iron for weapons.
